name: 🔴 Backend Timeout / Deadlock
description: API call exceeded the timeout — backend was slow or deadlocked. Not a test logic failure.

name: 🔴 Network / Connection Failure
description: curl-level network error: ECONNRESET, ECONNREFUSED, socket hang up. Backend unreachable.

name: 🟠 Request Context Disposed
description: Playwright request context was closed before the API call completed — test timed out at framework level.
messageRegex: .*Request context disposed.*|.*apiRequestContext.*disposed.*|.*Target page.*closed.*|.*context was destroyed.*|.*page has been closed.*

name: 🟠 Server-Side Error (5xx)
description: Backend returned HTTP 500/503 — server-side failure, not test logic.

name: 🟡 ERP Validation Error (4xx)
description: Backend rejected the request with a 4xx — missing required fields or business rule violation.

name: 🟡 Global Setup / Seeding Failure
description: Test failed because global setup or data seeding did not complete correctly.

name: 🔵 UI / Selector Timeout
description: Playwright could not find a UI element within the timeout — likely a rendering or navigation delay.

name: 🔵 Assertion / Business Logic Failure
description: Test assertion failed — actual ERP behavior did not match expected business logic.

name: ⚪ Known Bug / Documented Finding
description: Intentionally logged as a known ERP behaviour gap — not a test infrastructure problem.
